subject: CAIQ control stewardship + region residency checklist and upload cadence
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ control stewardship + region residency checklist and upload cadence

Team —

Per OmniBank's CAIQ review, they want: (1) control-level owners for each CSA control in scope, (2) a short artifact list per control, and (3) confirmation that evidence for EU-scoped controls lives in EU-resident storage.

I started a lightweight stewardship matrix (attached) and sketched a residency diagram. Can each of you take ownership of the controls shaded in the matrix and confirm the following by EOD:

- Owner name + backup
- List of 1–3 artifacts that prove the control (filename + location)
- Whether the artifact is EU-resident or provides an EU copy/replica
- A single sample export we can share with Catalyst Security (redacted logs OK)

Suggested chunks: Marissa — operational telemetry & runtime isolation controls; Kimberly — key management, rotation, HSM attestations; Marcus — deployment/config controls, RBAC and change logs.

Upload cadence: propose we stage artifacts in the Drive folder (link below) by 10:00 UTC tomorrow and then we’ll hand off to Catalyst for annotation. I’ve copied the OmniBank contact to keep them in the loop.

Attachments: caiq_control_stewardship_matrix_v1.xlsx, data_residency_diagram_eu-setup.png

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control stewardship + region residency checklist and upload cadence

Lauren —

Acknowledged. I’ll own the runtime telemetry and isolation controls (CSA/CCM mappings: NET-4, INF-2, RTE-1 in our crosswalk).

Planned artifacts:
- telemetry-retention-policy.pdf (Drive: /OmniBank/Telem) — EU replica via GCS bucket eu-west1
- kv-cache-access-sample.log (attached) — sample from EU staging cluster, redacted (IPs and tenant IDs scrubbed)
- isolation-test-report-202704.pdf — shows tenant segregation test results

I’ll upload the redacted kv-cache log and link the bucket snapshots by 10:00 UTC.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Controls Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control stewardship + region residency checklist and upload cadence

Lauren —

Taking KMS/HSM and crypto controls (CCM keys: CRY-1, CRY-2). Quick notes:
- We have recent HSM attestation (HSM-Attest-202704.pdf) stored in the secure EU bucket; link will be in Drive.
- Key rotation logs are in Vault audit export (vault-rotation-eu-2027-04.csv). That's exportable; I plan to provide a 7-day sample.
- For proof of KMS isolation: small diagram + policy doc (kms-separation-policy.md).

I’ve attached the rotation export sample and will place the full attestation in the Drive folder with restricted ACLs.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Manager, Cloud Security
Redwood Inference
From: Eve Harrison <eve.harrison@omnibank.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Catalyst Security <security@catalystsec.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control stewardship + region residency checklist and upload cadence

Thanks Lauren/Marissa/Kim —

This looks good. A couple quick asks from OmniBank security: please ensure any log samples are time-window stamped (we need UTC), and include a short guide (1 page) describing how to validate the artifact (what to look for). For KMS/HSM evidence, we need confirmation that key material for EU-scoped tenants never leaves the eu-west1 region.

Catalyst will perform a first pass annotation once you upload. If anything is non-EU-resident, flag it explicitly and propose compensating controls.

Eve Harrison
Client Security Lead — OmniBank
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Eve Harrison <eve.harrison@omnibank.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control stewardship + region residency checklist and upload cadence

Quick update: I’ve assigned owners in the stewardship matrix (column populated), added a backup for each owner, and linked a short validation checklist per control. Also uploaded data_residency_diagram_eu-setup.png and a short ACL checklist to the Drive folder.

Note on residency: deployment artifacts are replicated to eu-west1 for the EU tenant shard; operational logs are archived in EU buckets and archived copies are retained per policy for 90 days. Any non-EU artifacts (build logs) have been marked and we included compensating evidence (access restrictions + CI gating policy).

I’ll ping Catalyst after you confirm the upload is complete.

Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
